title: Resolutive Inference v0.2.0rc1
description: Resolutive Inference is an experimental framework for compact, deterministic and auditable sequential inference. Version 0.2.0rc1 is an experimental PC/server release candidate centered on the CompactRobust119 reference model, with four latent states, seven observed features and 119 stored scalar statistics. The release includes floating-point, Q4/LUT-128 and integer lag-8 execution paths, a C++17 reference kernel, a FastAPI REST/WebSocket server, model versioning, stateful sessions, optional persistence, API-key authentication and compiled-engine caching. Controlled synthetic experiments include comparisons with Gaussian HMM and Student-t HMM baselines. These experiments are intended for reproducibility and controlled evaluation and do not establish universal superiority over other inference methods. The primary release target is PC/server. ESP32/MCU support remains experimental. Software is distributed under the Resolutive Research and Non-Commercial License (RRNCL) 1.0.
